Hi Sofie,

Thanks for reaching out about a chatbot for your webshop — that sounds like a great fit. Cost and timeline depend on a few things, like the features you need and how it should connect to your current setup. If you can share a bit more about what you have in mind, I'll put together a quote and get back to you on both the price and how quickly it could go live.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Michiel

Hi Mark,

Thanks for reaching out, and great to hear the restaurant AI case study caught your attention. I'd be happy to have a 30-minute intro call to learn more about the portfolio company and how I might help.

Feel free to share a few times that work for you, and we'll get something on the calendar. Looking forward to connecting.

Best regards,
Michiel

Hello Jan,

The best solution depends on your current tools and workflows, so I'd be happy to discuss your situation in more detail. If you're interested, we could set up a short call to explore what would fit.

Best regards,
Michiel

Hi Laura,

If it's easier, we could also set up a quick call to go through the details.

Thanks for your patience!

Michiel

Would a short call this week work for you to go over the details?

Best regards,
Michiel

Ik kom zo snel mogelijk met een concreet voorstel bij je terug, zodat je het vrijdag aan het budget kunt voorleggen.

Zullen we dit kort telefonisch of per mail overleggen?

De votre côté, quelques éléments nous seraient utiles : des exemples de questions fréquentes de vos clients, un accès à vos informations produits, et une idée du volume de demandes reçues.

Je vous ferai parvenir quelques créneaux d'appel pour convenir d'un moment.

Bien cordialement,
Michiel

Je reviendrai vers vous dès que possible avec le chiffre précis — je vais tout faire pour vous répondre rapidement.

Merci de votre compréhension.

Michiel
